# ramble_organization_member (Resource)

A user's membership of a Ramble organisation, with a role.

Creating this resource for a user who is already a member adopts the membership and sets its role.

The user who owns the API token is the first owner of every organisation they create, without any `ramble_organization_member`. Managing that membership with this resource is possible but risky: an organisation must keep at least one owner, so setting the role to `member` or destroying the resource fails with `last_owner` while the token's user is the only owner. Removing the token's user while another owner exists succeeds, but the token then loses its rights over the organisation. Do not manage the membership of the token's own user unless another owner exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ramble_organization" "platform" {
  name = "platform-team"
}

# Creating this for a user who is already a member adopts the membership and
# sets the role.
resource "ramble_organization_member" "alice" {
  organization = ramble_organization.platform.name
  username     = "alice"
  role         = "member"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Name of the organisation. Changing it replaces the resource; a change of letter case only does not.
- `role` (String) Either `owner` or `member`. Changed in place.
- `username` (String) Username of the member. The user must exist. Changing it replaces the resource; a change of letter case only does not.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `organization/username`, as given when the resource was created or imported.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by organisation name and username, separated by a slash.
terraform import ramble_organization_member.alice platform-team/alice
```
